items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Well, that was only on the carnival.

ctx.x: What kind of clarinet did you play in that band? The B-flat. B-flat. You never had any B-flat parts, huh?

I mean, you couldn't, for a, in the Eureka and the Margie's, all that's E-flat parts, didn't you? Yeah. How'd you make out? Well, I just, I just go ahead and play my ideas. Well, you didn't use that? I didn't ever. You see, I could use a tenor saxophone part of all. Oh, you play tenor? No, saxophone parts. Oh, I see. Tenor saxophone parts. Oh, I see. So you got around at that one. Yeah. You must have played with some other brass bands. I think you mentioned the John McConnier. Oh, yeah. Well, that was only on the…
He told me about that. Yeah, he was in that band.
